description: Durable notification center shared by generation, usage and media. Authority: docs/architecture/ai-generation-platform.md section 12 and docs/product/ai-layer-2026-10.md section 4. The center is general, not AI-specific. Conventions (private/no-store, decimal-string versions, strong quoted ETag, RFC 9457) follow contracts/decks and contracts/items.

fields.seq: Decimal string, per owner, strictly increasing; the order and the read watermark use it. Allocated under the owner's notification_cursor row lock (the row is created on first use): UPDATE notification_cursor SET last_seq = last_seq + 1 WHERE owner_id = :id RETURNING last_seq, in the publishing transaction, with UNIQUE (owner_id, seq). A global bigserial would not work: its values are assigned before commit, so a lower value can commit after a poller read a higher one and the notification would be missed forever.
fields.kind: One of the kinds below. A client ignores unknown kinds (shows nothing, still counts them unread).
fields.severity: INFO | WARNING | ERROR: drives the glyph and the toast duration, never the only signal (the text always names the outcome).
fields.params: Object of at most 4 KiB; the fields per kind below. No server-rendered prose and no personal data: no email, name, titles, note or material text, only identifiers, counts, enums and timestamps. The client builds the sentence from kind and params and fetches titles itself.
fields.route: WORKSHOP (params.deckId, params.sessionId) | DECK (params.deckId) | PLANS | NONE; the kind table says DYNAMIC where the producer picks one. The client maps the key to its own URL; the server never sends a URL.
fields.expiresAt: createdAt + 30 days (exactly; same time of day).

model.storage: notification(notification_id, owner_id, seq, kind, severity, params, route, dedupe_key, created_at, dismissed_at, expires_at) with UNIQUE(owner_id, dedupe_key) and UNIQUE(owner_id, seq); notification_cursor(owner_id, last_seq, read_upto). Dismissed and expired rows are absent from reads.
model.producer: NotificationPublisher.publish(...) runs in the same transaction as the domain change. A second publish with an existing (owner, dedupeKey) is a no-op: the first one stands and is never refreshed.

toastDurations.note: The 3 s toast of the product contract is the echo of the user's own action; it is a client toast, not a notification. During Study toasts wait for a natural pause (client setting).

GENERATION_PLAN_READY.when: The session enters PLAN_READY: the plan waits for the user's approval.

params.plannedCount: integer >= 1: artifacts in the proposed plan

GENERATION_READY.when: The session entered REVIEW (or CLOSED) with every artifact approvable and none FAILED.

params.approvableCount: integer: artifacts approvable now (PROPOSED with every media slot READY or REMOVED); equals artifactCount here

GENERATION_PARTIAL.when: The session reached REVIEW with at least one approvable and at least one FAILED artifact.

GENERATION_FAILED.when: The session ended with no approvable artifact and at least one FAILED, or the PLAN step failed. Never produced for a user cancellation (endReason USER_CANCELLED).

params.errorCode: the most frequent artifact errorCode of the session (generation/states.json artifact.errorCodes); ties go to the first in that list

USAGE_LOW.when: A bucket's used share first crosses a threshold (80, 90, 100) in the period; the dedupe key includes the threshold, so each fires once per bucket, period and threshold.

params.bucket: CREDITS | STT | ASSESSMENT | PODCASTS | QUALITY_IMAGES | HIGH_FACTCHECK | SMART_PLAN
params.percent: integer 80..100, floor of the used share when the threshold was crossed

USAGE_EXHAUSTED.when: A bucket reaches 0 remaining in a window. The key names the window instance (windowStart), so a weekly Free bucket fires every week.

params.bucket: CREDITS | STT | ASSESSMENT | PODCASTS | QUALITY_IMAGES | HIGH_FACTCHECK | SMART_PLAN
params.renewsAt: UTC RFC 3339 or null when waiting will not help

GENERATION_SESSION_EXPIRING.when: Three days before expires_at while unpublished artifacts remain. The key includes the expiresAt date, so activity that moves the expiry produces a new notification for the new date.

params.pendingCount: integer >= 1: unpublished artifacts that would be deleted

MEDIA_PROCESSING_FAILED.producer: media processing and generation media steps (AI-07, #284)
MEDIA_PROCESSING_FAILED.when: A media asset reaches a terminal failure the user can act on: the media pipeline (FAILED_PERMANENT or exhausted retries) or a generation media step (slot FAILED). The notification route is WORKSHOP when sessionId is set, DECK when only deckId is set, else NONE (route DYNAMIC in the kind table).

query.after: decimal seq: catch-up mode, returns notifications with seq greater than it in ASCENDING seq order (oldest first, up to limit; nextCursor continues)
query.cursor: opaque: next page of the default newest-first listing

headers.ETag: strong quoted opaque validator over (latest seq, readUpto, dismissal changes, activeWork, earliest expiry boundary)

notes: Without `after` the list is the newest-first page (seq descending) and `cursor` pages to older ones. With `after` the list is ascending for catch-up; `after` and `cursor` together are INVALID_REQUEST.

requestBody.readUpto: decimal seq the client has displayed

errors.when: readUpto is malformed or greater than the latest seq (it could mark future notifications read)

notes: Monotonic maximum: a value not above the stored one changes nothing and returns the stored one. Idempotent, so no If-Match or commandId.

listResponseFields.items: Default: newest first (seq descending), not dismissed, not expired. With `after`: ascending.
listResponseFields.unreadCount: Number of items in the whole center (not just this page) with seq greater than readUpto. The bell shows 99+ above 99.
listResponseFields.activeWork: Integer: the owner's generation sessions in PLANNING or RUNNING (a PLAN_READY session waits on the owner and is not counted). Greater than 0 switches the client to the fast poll.

polling.backgroundTab: paused or at the idle interval
polling.rule: Send If-None-Match with the last ETag; a 304 costs no body. The ETag includes the earliest expiry boundary so an expiring notification invalidates it.
